name: us-open-box-red-dresses
image_purpose: show a polished sporting-event fashion moment

prompt.project_info: Photorealistic candid fashion portrait at a high-end outdoor tennis event.
prompt.main_subject: Two generic approved adult women standing side by side in a spectator box. One has platinum-blonde hair, slim black oval sunglasses, vibrant red sleeveless mock-neck top and matching red tweed mini skirt with black-white fringe trim, gold watch. The other has wavy brunette hair, dark angular sunglasses, red spaghetti-strap ruffled mini dress and small hoop earrings. Both hold translucent cocktails with ice and melon-ball garnishes.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical 9:16 portrait, two women leaning slightly on a blue railing, looking off-camera left with candid focused expressions, blue stadium seats, blurred crowd and tennis court behind. Preserve the visible RESERVED sign on the foreground railing.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Natural daylight with soft even sun, realistic skin texture, subtle highlights on sunglasses and drinks, exclusive energetic stadium atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic 85mm lens, f/1.8, shallow depth of field, sharp subjects, natural color grading, realistic drinks and hands, no artificial HDR.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Photorealistic vertical 9:16 candid tennis-event fashion portrait of two generic approved adult women in a spectator box, platinum blonde in red tweed top and skirt with black oval sunglasses and gold watch, brunette in red ruffled spaghetti-strap dress with angular sunglasses and hoop earrings, both holding translucent melon-ball cocktails, leaning on blue railing with RESERVED sign, blue stadium seats, tennis court and blurred crowd, natural daylight, 85mm f/1.8 editorial realism, chic energetic tennis-core mood.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, transparent clothing, sexualized posing, fetish styling, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, distorted hands, extra fingers, deformed anatomy, illegible typography, random text, logos

assets.name: us-open-box-red-dresses-reference
assets.usage: Match both generic adult subjects, red outfits, sunglasses, cocktails, stadium composition, blue railing and RESERVED typography. Replaceable with another approved two-person tennis spectator reference only if the two-subject hierarchy and event context remain.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required reference image. Preserve both adult identities as generic approved subjects, each outfit and accessory, the two-person arrangement, cocktails, tennis stadium, blue railing, and visible RESERVED text. Optional replacement references may change faces, hair, outfit details, or event seating while retaining two subjects and the sporting-event story. Preserve typography exactly when retained; remove unrelated logos and text.
